title: GraphQL Schema Module Compiler
description: Compiles a GraphQL SDL schema from domain entities. Enforces: schema parses without errors, no __unsafe__ fields exposed, nullable vs non-null correctly declared, pagination uses Relay connection spec (if paginated), mutations return payload types (not root entity directly), all types have descriptions.

error_codes.GS003: Sensitive field exposed (password, token, secret, hash) without @internal or @deprecated
error_codes.GS004: Mutation returns root entity directly — must return payload type (e.g. CreateUserPayload)
error_codes.GS005: Paginated query does not use Relay connection spec (edges/node/pageInfo)
